channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on July 29, 2026 : Iran proposes temporary Strait of Hormuz deal with Oman, warns waterway will remain shut if rejected
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on July 29, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Iran proposes temporary Strait of Hormuz deal with Oman, warns waterway will remain shut if rejected
item.description: The proposal comes amid heightened tensions following months of conflict involving Iran, the United States and Israel, and renewed efforts to restore commercial shipping through one of the world's busiest energy chokepoints.

item.title: Trump, Zelensky hold White House talks on Ukraine peace process, Patriot missile co-production
item.description: Following the meeting, Zelensky described the discussions as productive and said the leaders focused on Trump's pledge made during this month's NATO summit to allow Ukraine to manufacture Patriot missile interceptors under licence.

item.title: Cartel Leader’s Ex-Wife Used Drug Money for Child’s Elite School
item.description: The ex-wife of the leader of a Mexican drug cartel pleaded guilty to using more than $500,000 in drug money to pay for her child’s tuition at an exclusive private school and athletic training facility in Florida.

item.title: Trump leads tributes to Lindsey Graham, calls late senator ‘a true American original’ at Washington memorial
item.description: The ceremony, attended by top US officials, lawmakers and foreign leaders including Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, honored Graham's more than three decades in Congress and his influence on US national security and foreign policy.

item.title: After Pickaxe spat, Trump-Netanyahu talks center on Iran nuclear threat; WH calls meeting ‘positive and productive’
item.description: The nearly 90-minute Oval Office meeting, which was closed to the press, marked the first face-to-face talks between the two leaders since the United States and Israel launched joint military operations against Iran earlier this year.

item.title: Iran threatens to block ships in Strait of Hormuz over Trump's plan to use frozen assets for compensation payments
item.description: The warning came after US President Donald Trump said future damages to ships, cargo and related maritime assets would be paid using Iranian funds held and controlled by Washington.

item.title: NEET UG paper leak case: CBI chargesheets 13 accused, Delhi Court to hear matter on Wednesday
item.description: The CBI has filed a chargesheet against 13 accused in the NEET UG paper leak case, while keeping its investigation into the role of NTA officials open.

item.title: 13 Indian sailors trapped on vessel at Ukraine’s Chornomorsk Port amid drone attacks, union seeks urgent evacuation
item.description: In a post on social media platform X, FSUI said M.V. AMIR1, currently docked at the Ukrainian port of Chornomorsk, has 15 crew members on board, including 13 Indian seafarers, who are facing a “terrible and life-threatening situation.”

item.title: After Elon Musk's ‘money won’t matter in 2036’ remark, Nobel economist asks him to ‘donate $1 trillion to charity then’
item.description: Elon Musk's comments have resurfaced after Nobel Prize-winning economist Acemoglu publicly challenged him over his views on artificial intelligence and wealth.

item.title: Virat Kohli-Anushka Sharma buy sea-facing luxury ₹18.29 crore apartment in Mumbai’s Versova
item.description: The actor-cricketer duo has acquired a sprawling sea-facing apartment in Mumbai’s upscale Versova neighbourhood for a staggering ₹18.29 crore.

item.title: PM asks ministries to break silos, boost tech self-reliance
item.description: At the meeting, the prime minister called for stronger team building, and urged the officials to work with a shared sense of purpose and break horizontal and vertical silos so that departments function in close coordination and deliver integrated outcomes.

item.title: MSMEs may get their payments faster as new bill aims to cut delays
item.description: The law will also mandate government procurers from MSMEs to only pay them through certified Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS).

item.title: US Intelligence layoffs: Acting DNI Bill Pulte says 30% workforce reduction underway
item.description: Acting DNI Pulte said that intelligence agencies should focus on national security rather than what he called the interests of a “bloated and corrupt elite class.”

item.title: Govt imposes sugar stock limits till November to rein in prices
item.description: The government said the restrictions are intended to ensure orderly domestic supplies, protect consumer interests and allow genuine trade and distribution activities to continue without disruption.

item.title: ‘BTech degree isn't enough anymore...’: Ex-Google recruiter reveals why real-world skills are important
item.description: The ex-Google recruiter said that he would always hire a failed entrepreneur, recognising that the sheer act of building a company takes immense courage and conviction.

item.title: Abhijeet Dipke warns govt of 'massive protest' if 'witch-hunting' of students continues
item.description: CJP chief Abhijeet Dipke warns of a ‘massive peaceful protest' if the government does not stop the alleged ’witch-hunting' of students after the NEET protests.

item.title: Prince William and Kate share heartwarming ‘Summer Rewind’ family photos, offer glimpse into royal moments
item.description: The Prince and the Princess of Wales posted the Instagram carousel on July 28, featuring highlights from royal engagements, charity work and intimate family moments with their three children.

item.title: IMD issues flash flood alert as heavy rain batters central India
item.description: The IMD also forecast normal to above-normal monsoon rainfall over northwest and central India during the next four to five days

item.title: After leading CJP protests, Abhijeet Dipke now faces flood of marriage proposals, says mother
item.description: Dipke's mother, Anita Dipke, said proposals had started arriving even before the CJP launched its agitation over the alleged NEET paper leak, but interest increased further as her son gained national attention.&nbsp;

item.title: Green card wait for Indians hits 15 years: Can new US bill bring relief to H-1B workers, long-term residents?
item.description: Senator Alex Padilla introduced a bill aiming to modernise US immigration, providing a pathway to permanent residency for long-term residents, particularly H-1B visa holders. The legislation seeks to amend outdated laws and has gained support from multiple senators and over 30 organisations.

item.title: Lindsey Graham funeral: Who is attending and how to watch
item.description: Graham, who died on July 11 at the age of 71 from a likely aortic dissection after returning from a trip to Ukraine and a NATO summit in Turkey, is being remembered with ceremonies at the US Capitol and the Washington National Cathedral before his burial in South Carolina.

item.title: Trump privately questioned if Lindsey Graham's demanding travel schedule contributed to his death: Report
item.description: Trump reportedly expressed surprise that someone as active as Graham could die so suddenly and privately wondered whether the senator's extensive travel schedule—including a trip to Ukraine shortly before his death—had taken a physical toll.

item.title: HCL employees chant 'We want a hike' as CEO Vijayakumar takes stage at Chennai event - viral video
item.description: The company has been organising a series of concerts across several cities, with the Chennai edition featuring an exclusive live performance by singer and composer Anirudh Ravichander for employees.

item.title: Rebuilding trust the real challenge, says IIT Madras director in exam task force
item.description: This year's NEET paper leak exposed a new weak link—the question setters. In an interview, V. Kamakoti, director at IIT Madras and member of the government's exam reforms task force, explains how AI, tougher vetting and possible multi-session testing could help restore confidence in India's exams.

item.title: Meta's explanation ‘not reasonable,’ says govt after PM Modi Facebook video removal
item.description: Meta's global affairs president and Instagram's chief were reportedly summoned via email because Meta's Indian policy team was unable to convey the seriousness of the issues to the US team.

item.title: Canara Bank steps up cyber checks, tech spend after Bank of Baroda breach
item.description: Canara Bank has earmarked over ₹2,000 crore towards IT and cybersecurity initiatives, CEO Brajesh Kumar Singh says, amid reports of a data breach at Bank of Baroda.

item.title: US diplomats walk out of UN meeting as France slams Trump's human rights record
item.description: The move came days after the United States opposed the reappointment of UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk, a decision that drew public criticism from France and highlighted growing disagreements between the two NATO partners.

item.title: Iran’s $23 billion oil cushion: Can Trump’s sanctions force Tehran to back down?
item.description: President Trump's economic pressure on Iran, including sanctions and blockades, is gaining attention as Iran faces an economic crisis. Officials believe financial measures may be more effective than military strikes in forcing Iranian compliance amid ongoing tensions over oil and military actions.

item.title: Why US officials believe sanctions, not bombs, will force Iran back to the table
item.description: US officials believe that sanctions and restrictions will harm Iran more than military action. Despite Trump halting strikes for diplomacy, Iran's economic pressures remain significant, including shortages and financial challenges in warfare financing.

item.title: Japan earthquake today: Several feared dead in Kashima Town's Aeon Mall as 7.1 quake triggers blast
item.description: Police said earlier they had received reports of what sounded like an explosion at the Aeon Mall outlet in the Kumamoto region

item.title: India launches first direct commercial freight train to Nepal from Kolkata
item.description: The historic movement marks the operationalisation of the revised India-Nepal Rail Transit Protocol and opens a new chapter in cross-border freight transportation.

item.title: Earthquake in Japan: Stone wall of 419-year-old Kumamoto Castle collapses during 7.1 quake | Viral video
item.description: Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said her government has set up a task force to gather information, assess possible damage and prepare for rescue operations if needed.

item.title: Dubai's ₹79,000 tourist referral scheme: What it is and how you can benefit
item.description: The scheme, launched earlier this month, is open to people aged 18 and above who hold a valid Emirates ID. Each participant can nominate up to three guests to travel to Dubai between now and 31 October.

item.title: PM Andy Burnham rules out stamp duty reform in next budget: Why is it a blow to British homebuyers?
item.description: British PM Andy Burnham dismissed any modifications to stamp duty in the next budget. While he may consider raising other taxes amid spending demands, the Labour Party has previously committed not to increase rates on income tax, national insurance, or VAT.
